items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You met Mr. Russell. I believe he was able to do Mr. Thompson. Mr. Collins. How do you do? How do you do? Please meet Mr. Thompson. [INTERVIEWEE] How do you do?

ctx.x: I'm having you, Mr. Thompson. Oh, yes, I'm here. That's Mr. Collins. I'm here. Thank you. I feel fine. You look fine. You look fine.
I can't get around. Yes, sir. Sure, sure, sure. Everybody's so kind here. That's nice. Go this way, man. Yeah, man. Go this way. Go on. It's not too cool in there for you, is it?
